name: node-validation
description: Reference dev-cycle validation provider for the econ-v1 node repo. Implements the validation contract by wrapping node's existing tests/e2e primitives (AuthClient, TestHarness.startWithChannel, regtest-up persistent cluster, injectAuth, ai-reporter) plus audit-flagged gaps (LPS-optional bring-up, live-FE-origin session, reset-e2e, :3002/:3000 port reconciliation). First consumer of the dev-cycle E2E harness contract.
